transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… mostly I just haven’t been eating much. Like at work, on my lunch break, I’ll get food I used to like and then just kind of stare at it… end up throwing most of it away. It’s been enough that I figured I should come in.
How long have you been experiencing this lack of interest in eating?
About two months, I guess. It started around when I got that window display award… and the district manager started paying more attention to me.
Have you lost any weight over the past two months?
I’m not really sure about the number. I haven’t been checking. I just… barely want to eat anymore. I’ll sit there on lunch with food I used to like and end up throwing most of it away.
Do you think you're fat or overweight, even when others say you're not?
No… I don’t think that’s it. I mean, I haven’t really been thinking about my weight that way.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No… I don’t think I’m afraid of that. It’s not really about gaining weight.
Do you feel anxious or stressed when you think about eating?
Not really anxious, no. It’s more like… I just don’t want it. I’ll be at lunch at the store with something I used to like, and I just stare at it and end up throwing most of it away.
Do you feel upset or uneasy when you think about not eating?
A little, I guess… mostly because I know I should eat, but I just don’t want to. Like at work, I’ll sit there with lunch and just end up tossing most of it.
Are you enjoying things you used to like, outside of eating?
Not really. Stuff I used to look forward to—like gallery nights, playing basketball, helping kids with art stuff—it just feels kind of… flat now. I usually end up making some excuse to leave.
Have you noticed any change in the way your clothes fit over the past two months?

Yeah… maybe a little looser, I guess. I haven’t really been keeping track. I just know I’ve barely been wanting to eat, even at lunch when I bring something I used to like. I’ll just sit there and end up throwing most of it away.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed most of the time over the past two months?
I don’t know… I mean, I’ve been down, yeah. Most days feel kind of heavy, I guess.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past two months?
I don’t know exactly how much. I just… barely want to eat anymore. Like at lunch at the store, I’ll stare at food I used to like and end up throwing most of it away.
Are you worried that eating will cause you any harm?
I don’t think so… not like I’m scared it’ll hurt me. I just don’t really feel like eating.
Are you avoiding eating because you think it might have some negative effect on you?
No… not because I think something bad will happen. I just don’t really want it. Like at lunch I’ll look at food I used to like and then… I end up throwing most of it away.
Do you think there's anything wrong with your body shape or size?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t really been thinking about my shape or size.
Have you lost more than 5% of your body weight over the past two months?
I’m not sure about the percent. I haven’t really checked. I just know I barely want to eat lately… at work I’ll sit with food on my lunch break and end up throwing most of it away.
Are you eating less because you're concerned something bad might happen if you eat normally?
No… it’s not like I’m scared something will happen. I just… barely want to eat. I’ll sit there on my lunch break with food I used to like and end up tossing most of it.
Have you noticed your weight dropping significantly since you started eating less?
I haven’t really weighed myself, so I don’t know how much. I just know I’m eating a lot less… like at lunch I’ll stare at food I used to like and then throw most of it away.
Have you had to buy smaller clothes due to weight loss over the past two months?
No… I haven’t bought smaller clothes or anything. I just know I’m not eating much anymore, especially at lunch. I’ll look at food I used to like and just end up throwing it away.
Are you avoiding food because of concerns about what might happen after you eat?
No… not because I’m worried about what happens after. I just don’t really want it. I’ll be at lunch with food I used to like and just end up throwing most of it away.
Are you afraid of any negative consequences that might happen as a direct result of eating?
No… I don’t think so. I’m not really scared something bad will happen if I eat. I just… don’t feel like eating much.
